LexicalMessageRenderer  Read-only Lexical editor surface for rendering chat messages with markdown support. Provides a unified editing experience across the application by using the same Lexical components for display as the main editor uses for editing.  Features: - Markdown parsing to Lexical AST - Code syntax highlighting - Support for all standard markdown elements (headings, lists, links, etc.) - Streaming support for real-time AI responses - Optimized for performance with React.memo
